Mina: Quick check — onboarding llama-7b-chat-ish model. Noticed small formatting drift when running local eval (responses have extra leading token). Weights: gs://rwd-models/onboard/llama-7b-chat-v2/weights.pt
Mina: Tokenizer dir: gs://rwd-models/onboard/llama-7b-chat-v2/tokenizer/ — can someone confirm canonical?
Alex: I can confirm the weights path. Infra pinned the bucket. However the tokenizer in that folder looks regenerated with sentencepiece v0.1.97; our HF JSON pipeline expects 'added_tokens' layout. That mismatch could change BOS/EOS ids.
Jordana: +1. We saw similar w/ earlier Llama builds — chat template used '<s>' as BOS but runtime expects '' as EOS. Check ids: tokenizer.token_to_id('<s>') vs tokenizer.eos_token_id. If not aligned you'll see stray tokens at beginning/end.
Sam: Quick diff I ran: the tokenizer.json currently has "bos_token": null. I pushed a proposed config tweak in the model card: set special_tokens explicitly. Example:
```json
{
  "special_tokens": {
    "bos_token": "<s>",
    "eos_token": "</s>",
    "unk_token": "<unk>"
  },
  "chat_template": {
    "system_prompt": "<|system|> {system}",
    "user_prefix": "<|user|>",
    "assistant_prefix": "<|assistant|>"
  }
}
```
Mina: Nice. Also runtime raised a KV cache warning when prefix_len > 128 during local smoke tests — maybe config mismatch?
Alex: For that set model.cfg `max_seq_len` to 2048 and runtime flag `preserve_kv_cache_order=true`. Also ensure tokenizer created with `add_bos_token=true` to match runtime expectations. I'll open a PR to update model config + token files.
Jordana: Ping @Sam for a quick CR on that PR. Also let's add a small eval set 'chat-bos-eos-sanity' to catch regressions in CI.
Sam: On it. I'll add a unit test that tokenizes system+user templates and asserts last token id == eos_token_id and first token == bos_token_id. Will include a short fixture in tests/tokenizer_sanity.py
deploy-bot: CI passed for model-onboard-config#142 — deployment queued to dedicated staging.
Mina: Great — will run the full eval after the staging deploy, ETA ~2h. :thumbsup:
